sources.title: Prompt a built-in language model with the Prompt API - Microsoft Edge ...
sources.snippet: The Prompt API is available as a developer preview in the Microsoft Edge Canary and Edge Dev channels, starting with version 138.0.3309.2. The Prompt API is intended to help discover use cases and understand challenges for built-in SLMs. This API is expected to be succeeded by other experimental APIs for specific AI-powered tasks such as writing assistance and text translation.
